About us

About CMT Medical Travel

We arrange health care and quiet recovery in Yunnan, tailored to you. Tell us what you need and we shape the plan, the clinic and the itinerary around it — then you finalise in your own way.

Why CMT

What We Offer

We connect you with health screening, TCM wellness, dental care and bespoke programmes in Yunnan, coordinating providers, appointments, bilingual support and travel arrangements.

How We Coordinate

Tell us what you are looking for, when you plan to travel and what matters to you. We then outline suitable healthcare options and travel arrangements. Clinical services are provided by partner institutions, while travel services are operated by a partner travel agency.

The Scope Of Our Service

CMT Health coordinates healthcare services but does not provide medical diagnoses or operate the travel itinerary. Travel services require a separate contract with the travel agency, whose terms govern pricing, changes, cancellations and responsibilities.
